issues.detail: The Greek text includes 'τις οπως αριστηση' (someone who was a guest/host), which is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.

The Vietnamese 'xin Ngài dùng bữa với mình' (asked Him to eat with him) is a slight shift from the Greek 'ηρωτα αυτον... παρ αυτω εισελθων' (asked Him... having entered with him), though it captures the general interaction. However, the omission of the status/role of the person ('αριστηση') is the primary fidelity issue.
